Priya: Quick sync 10: planning an operator-export sim for tenant-scoped wrapping keys. Need minimal RBAC, required logs, and IR checklist.

Luca: Minimal RBAC: ephemeral role bound to a single synthetic key, actions: kms:GenerateWrappedKey only, TTL 1h. No wildcards.

Claire: Logging: enable proxy debug, tag requests with sim=true, retain logs 90d. Collect HSM audit records (operator-id, command, signature), KMS admin audit, and host process list.

Priya: I27ll ensure the change has a JIRA approval and Legal sign-off. We will notify affected BYOK customers with opt-out.

Luca: IR steps: revoke ephemeral role immediately on anomaly, rotate only the synthetic canary key, do not touch customer-owned keys. Post findings in #incidents and produce signed run report.

Claire: Add filter examples: protoPayload.methodName:("GenerateWrappedKey" OR "ImportKeyMaterial") and proxy tag = sim=true. Save raw artifacts to secure bucket with access audit.

ops-bot: Reminder: maintenance window Tue 09:00-10:30 PT. Pager escalation enabled for sim.

Priya: Good. I27ll create the JIRA, attach the RBAC snippet and runbook fragment, and post back here when ready. Thanks all.
